items.title: The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B just weeks after launch
items.summary: TypeSafe AI 开发的非文本 AI 模型 Jev 发布仅数周后，以 75 亿美元估值完成 8.7 亿美元融资，由 Andreessen Horowitz 领投、Sequoia 和 DCVC 参投。Jev 基于 transformer 架构但并非大语言模型（LLM），输出概率而非文本，号称运行速度显著快于 LLM 且 token 消耗大幅降低，目前已获三分之一财富 500 强企业采用，定位于自动化任务而非文本或代码生成。

items.title: OpenAI 年化收入约 500 亿美元并寻求 300 亿美元新融资
items.summary: OpenAI截至9月底年化营收约500亿美元，预计2026年底将达到700亿美元，正以1.4万亿美元投前估值寻求至少300亿美元新融资。Q3企业营收跃升107%，驱动整体收入增长77%，目前已有250万家企业使用其产品，ChatGPT每周用户超12亿。公司通过GPT-6.1-Sol和Codex等产品加码企业市场，并在价格战中与Anthropic展开竞争。

items.title: A new feature for my blog, built using my voice
items.summary: 作者使用 ChatGPT 桌面端的 Codex 语音模式（GPT-6 Astra High 模型），在半小时内通过语音对话完成博客"Newsletter 页面"功能：新增 Django 模型与迁移，实现四条数据导入（Substack RSS、Substack API、GitHub 公共仓库、私密赞助商仓库），并生成 /newsletters/ 归档页与搜索引擎集成，仅在日期归档页展示而不出现在标签页或首页。

items.title: Show HN: Claude Opus 5.5 Video prompts and skills
items.summary: 该资源合集收录了使用 Claude Opus 5.5 生成的 390 个视频示例、351 个提示词及 46 个可复用技能，涵盖产品演示、动态排版、数据可视化、角色动画等 10 大类场景。每个示例均附有原始提示词、模型参数及创作流程说明，用户可通过替换主题、文案和视觉素材直接适配自身

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.summary: Anthropic 开源了包含 11 个插件的知识工作插件仓库（anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins），面向 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code，覆盖 productivity、sales、customer-support、product-management、marketing、legal、finance、data、enterprise

items.title: Show HN: Faplex – like `Claude agents` but all machines and harnesses
items.summary: Faplex 是一款跨机器统一管理 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 会话状态的轻量级工具，通过 SSH 连接多台主机，提供实时分组状态列表（Working、Needs input、Finished）及上下文 token 数。该工具不接管终端或会话，仅读取各 harness 报告的状态后调用 `claude attach`、`codex resume` 等原生命令打开真实 CLI。运行方式为 `bunx faplex` 或通过 `faplex devbox pi`

items.title: Show HN: Clanking – Turn your coding agents' activity into a subtle soundscape
items.summary: Clanking 是一款用 Go 语言开发的开源工具，能将 Claude、Codex 等 LLM agent 的操作活动实时转化为立体声音效景观，帮助开发者通过听觉感知多 agent 工作状态。该工具基于 PipeWire 和 pw-cat 实现，默认 120 BPM 节拍量化音效，并通过左右声道定位区分不同 agent 会话位置。项目支持 CLI 和 GTK 4 图形界面配置，可通过插件市场一键安装至 Claude 或 Codex 环境。

items.title: 陶哲轩转发抵制声明，数学界和OpenAI彻底撕破脸
items.summary: OpenAI一次性发布722篇数学手稿，引发数学界强烈反弹。人类数学协会（约809名成员）发表声明呼吁抵制OpenAI，28位菲尔兹奖得主也签署宣言表达担忧。其中仅162篇结果经Lean验证

items.title: ARC Prize 2026：TUFA Labs 以 88.06% 登顶 ARC-AGI-2 高分榜
items.summary: TUFA Labs 在 ARC Prize 2026 赛季 ARC-AGI-2 高分榜以 88.06% 的成绩登顶，触发 15 万美元 Bonus Prize，该奖金由所有得分超过 85% 的团队共享。榜单第二名 Rabbithole 得分为 80.56%，第三至第五名分别为 Yi-Chia Chen（77.22%）、Nubanana（77.08%）和 _hans（67.64%）。
items.summary_en: TUFA Labs topped the ARC Prize 2026 ARC-AGI-2 leaderboard with 88.06%. A $150,000 Bonus Prize will be shared among all teams scoring above 85%, alongside a guaranteed $100,000 prize. The top five includes Rabbithole (80.56%), Yi-Chia Chen (77.22%), Nubanana (77.08%), and _hans (67.64%).

items.title: Mistral Large 4 进入 Agent Arena 前十五实验室，排名第 43
items.summary: Mistral Large 4 在 Agent Arena 中基于超 5000 个真实智能体会话测试，净改进分为 -6.6%，总排名第 43，较前代 Mistral Medium 3.5（-12.60%）提升 11 位，在开放模型中排第 13 名。该模型由 MistralAI 开发，预计 10 月底发布开放权重版本，也是 Agent Arena 前 15 实验室中唯一的欧洲团队作品。
items.summary_en: Mistral Large 4 by Mistral AI has entered the Agent Arena top 15 labs, ranking 43rd overall based on over 5,000 real-world agent sessions with a net improvement score of -6.6%, outperforming its predecessor Mistral Medium 3.5 (-12.60%) by 11 positions. It would rank 13th among open-weight models once its weights are released at the end of October, making Mistral the only European lab in the Arena's top 15.

items.title: 《柳叶刀》研究表明：AI 有望改善医患关系
items.summary_en: Google's AMIE diagnostic AI chatbot, tested on 98 patients at BIDMC outpatient clinics and published in *The Lancet* for the first time, achieved a 90% match between its differential diagnoses and physicians' final confirmations, while AI summaries aided doctor preparation in 75% of cases and altered clinical reasoning in over half. No conversation required interruption under preset safety criteria, demonstrating AI's potential to improve doctor-patient relationships and reduce healthcare workers' burden, though larger-scale clinical trials are still needed before broad deployment.

items.title: 0.2秒急停、秒级重规划！因果智能走进真实世界
items.summary_en: CRIS-0 is a causal-native robot system developed by Aether AI, capable of 0.2-second emergency stops and average 2-second replanning under external disturbances, recovering successfully in 9 out of 10 random perturbation tests during a coffee preparation task. Built around a causal world model (CausalWM), the architecture decomposes tasks into verifiable causal stages using rule-based motion functions, policy models, SLAM navigation, and a verification loop, enabling robust long-horizon tasks and common-sense reasoning. items.title: 全球最大独立 AI 原生影视公司，要打造「AI 版 Disney」
items.summary_en: Utopai Studios, the world's largest independent AI-native film company, has become the first to join Hollywood unions and pre-sell projects like *Space Nation* and *Cortés* to traditional broadcasters (Brazil's Globo, German TV) for up to $110 million combined. Its proprietary video model, Utopai X, ranks #2 globally and #1 in the US on AI Analysis's text-to-video blind benchmark, built on MiniMax H3 with optimizations for cinematic continuity, lighting, and physics. The company operates through its Production Assist
